source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Five adds: Washington County's Warfield Point on the Mississippi, the Pearl River Valley Water Supply District's Coal Bluff, Monroe County's Morgan's Landing, the Canton Multipurpose Complex RV park and Mississippi State's John W. Starr RV Park (state). MS's water-park districts were already well covered; Elvis Presley Lake is held (closed since 2023, possibly permanently).

added.name: John W. Starr Memorial Forest RV Park

excluded.name: Dunn's Falls Water Park (PHWD)
excluded.why: a handful of primitive tables, no defined RV sites

excluded.name: Camp Shelby Lake Walker, Keesler FamCamp, Harrison County Fairgrounds

held.name: Elvis Presley Lake Campground (Tupelo)
held.why: 16 paved W/E sites; closed for renovation in 2023 and 2024 reviews suggest it has not reopened; operator unconfirmed

other.name: (private gap)
other.why: ~15 private unmatched incl. casino RV parks (Tunica, Vicksburg, Biloxi)
